thesis: The podcast argues that ground infrastructure is the most overlooked bottleneck in the space economy because it has lagged behind the rapid modernization of spacecraft manufacturing and launch cadence. Bridget Membler of Northwood contends that without modernized ground infrastructure, satellites are merely 'rocks in space' and that the industry needs a vertically integrated approach to align incentives and connect satellites back to Earth effectively.
